notes: Guides are Leonida Ledger's own words. Each step names the public source its facts come from; nothing is copied. miss.status is missable, unconfirmed or safe, read from the official description and the cited guides.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

miss.note: Follows the other 54; only the Chapter 1 meditation can be lost on the way.

trophies.guide: Unlocks by itself once the other 54 trophies are earned; the whole list is single-player, with no online or DLC trophy. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: Earn the other 54. None of them needs GTA Online or DLC, so one single-player save carries the whole list.
Budget roughly 200 hours; PowerPyx rates the list about 4 out of 10 for difficulty and says one playthrough is enough.
Cheats switch off trophies and saving for that session, so keep them off for the whole run.
Push Square's roadmap also counts no online trophies and puts the bulk of the time into the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

miss.note: Gone Fishing is a main mission the story cannot skip.

trophies.guide: Automatic: it pops when you finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: Gone Fishing opens Chapter 1. Finish it and the trophy unlocks on its own.
GTABase files it as a story unlock that nobody can miss.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost

miss.note: Story progress; it cannot be skipped.

trophies.guide: Automatic: it lands after What's in the Bag?, the first mission of Chapter 2. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: The Chapter 1 trophy does not pop at the chapter's last mission; it arrives once you clear What's in the Bag?, the opener of Chapter 2.
Before leaving Chapter 1, take Lucia up on the balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

miss.note: Story progress; it cannot be skipped.

trophies.guide: Automatic: it lands after Welcome to Vice City, the first mission of Chapter 3. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: Play on into Chapter 3; clearing its first mission, Welcome to Vice City, awards the Chapter 2 trophy.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

miss.note: Story progress; it cannot be skipped.

trophies.guide: Automatic: it lands after Ocean Beach and Another Life, the first two missions of Chapter 4. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: The Chapter 3 trophy waits until you have cleared both Ocean Beach and Another Life at the start of Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

miss.note: Story progress; GTABase says it cannot be missed.

trophies.guide: Automatic: Starting From Zero, the last mission of Chapter 4, awards it. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: Starting From Zero closes Chapter 4; finishing it gives this trophy straight away.
GTABase lists it as a plain story unlock with no way to miss it.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

miss.note: Story finale. No mission replay, but no trophy depends on how a mission is played.

trophies.guide: Gold for the campaign's last mission. Free roam goes on afterwards, but missions cannot be replayed, so keep a manual save first. Sources: PSNProfiles, PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: Finish the last story mission of Chapter 5 for the gold.
You keep playing in free roam after the credits, but no mission can be replayed; make a separate manual save before the finale.
GTABase adds that nothing on the list hangs on how you play a mission, so the lack of replay costs no trophy.

trophies.name: Trust

miss.note: Breakfast Run is a main mission the story cannot skip.

trophies.guide: Automatic: Breakfast Run is a Chapter 2 main mission. Sources: PowerPyx walkthrough, GTABase.

steps.text: Breakfast Run comes up in the Chapter 2 story; complete it and Trust unlocks.

trophies.name: Break the Bank

miss.note: The Cartel Heist is a main mission the story cannot skip.

trophies.guide: Automatic: The Cartel Heist is a Chapter 3 story mission. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 3 story through The Cartel Heist; the trophy follows on its own.

trophies.name: Family Matters

miss.note: Child's Play is a main mission the story cannot skip.

trophies.guide: Automatic: Child's Play is part of the Chapter 4 story. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: Child's Play is a Chapter 4 main mission; clear it to unlock Family Matters.

trophies.name: DWNFALL

miss.note: Headliners is a main mission the story cannot skip.

trophies.guide: Automatic: Headliners is a Chapter 4 main mission. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: Headliners sits in the Chapter 4 story; finishing it awards DWNFALL.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

miss.note: VCIA Takedown is a main mission the story cannot skip.

trophies.guide: Automatic: VCIA Takedown comes up during Chapter 4. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: VCIA Takedown is a Chapter 4 story mission; it gives the trophy when you finish it.

trophies.name: Snow Storm

miss.note: Operation Savage Glory is a main mission the story cannot skip.

trophies.guide: Automatic: Operation Savage Glory is a Chapter 5 story mission. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: Operation Savage Glory arrives in Chapter 5; clear it and Snow Storm unlocks.

trophies.name: A Long Road

miss.note: Both guides say nothing on the 100% checklist can be missed; all of it stays open in free roam.

trophies.guide: Work through the 100% checklist under Progress > Stats; it is lenient (about 60% of everything) and stays open in free roam. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: After the story, open Progress > Stats for the 100% checklist. What you did earlier already counts, and all of it can be finished in free roam.
It is lighter than it sounds: most side quests are not on it, and collectibles are only partly required, such as 200 of 277 base vehicles scanned and 70 of 80 challenges.
The parts that need everything are robberies (all 8 bank vaults and 39 gang operations), underwater discoveries, every range gold, all drone races and Bret's 15 Target Decks.
Partial items GTABase lists: 100 optional missions, 100 of 255 animals studied, 15 of 18 meditations, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

miss.note: Stunt spots stay on the map after the story.

trophies.guide: Any mix of stunt jumps, bridge and knife flights and base jumps counts; the 100% list wants 300, so this comes on the way. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: Stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights between buildings and base jumps all add to one total of 250.
GTABase counts 397 stunts in all (202 of them bridge flights), so flying under bridges is the fast route; the side challenge on each is optional.
The 100% checklist asks for 300 stunts, so chase that and this silver unlocks on the way.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.

miss.note: Every activity type is open in free roam.

trophies.guide: Start each of the nine activity types once; Progress > Activities shows which you still lack. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: There are nine activity types. Playing one of each is the whole requirement.
The nine, per GTABase: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (one basket), an arcade game, a race win and a stunt.
Progress > Activities lists every category with your count, so the missing type is easy to spot.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.

miss.note: Ranges stay open after the story and are on the 100% checklist.

trophies.guide: Gold all 42 shooting range challenges across 12 ranges; the PS5 tracker counts each gold. Sources: PSNProfiles, PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: The trophy tracker climbs to 42, one gold for each shooting range challenge.
GTABase spreads those 42 over 12 ranges and notes the ranges also level your Focus, which helps with Gunslinger.
PowerPyx calls the range golds manageable, and they are on the 100% checklist too, so none can be skipped.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.

miss.note: Drone races stay open after the story.

trophies.guide: Win at least one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. Sources: PSNProfiles, PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: There are 14 drone race locations; one win at each fills the tracker.
100% wants all 42 drone races, so clear every race at a location while you are there.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

miss.note: Races are free-roam activities with no story lockout.

trophies.guide: Win 20 distinct races out of the 40 on offer; winning the same race twice adds nothing. Sources: PSNProfiles, GTABase.

steps.text: Only first wins in different races count toward the 20, so move on after each victory.
GTABase counts 40 races to pick from, so you can skip the hardest half.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.

miss.note: PowerPyx: every trophy quest giver is still there after the story.

trophies.guide: After meeting Cal in Feng Shui (Chapter 1), follow his text to the purple fishing marker and win his challenge. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: Cal texts you once you have met him in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, and a purple fishing marker appears.
Follow his fishing questline until his challenge and beat him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

miss.note: Three of the four games sit on the TV at home.

trophies.guide: Clear every level of any one of the four arcade games; its bonus challenges are optional. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: Pick one of the four playable arcade games and beat all of its levels. The extra challenges inside the game are not needed.
Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind run on the TV at home; Bang For Your Buck is on cabinets around Leonida.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.

miss.note: GTABase: Andy's jobs are still there after the story.

trophies.guide: Andy's five jobs are Lucia's, from Chapter 3; the last, Puff Puff Pass, gives the trophy. Sources: PowerPyx walkthrough, GTABase.

steps.text: Andy texts Lucia a Belville address in Chapter 3; his strand is Lucia-only.
Play his five jobs in order through to the last one, Puff Puff Pass.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.

miss.note: Kenton leaves after Chapter 1 but texts Jason again in Chapter 2 or 3; PowerPyx says he is not missable.

trophies.guide: Kenton's diving strand starts in Chapter 1: clear 7 shipwrecks at the purple chest markers and bring the treasure back. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: Kenton calls after Island Dreams in Chapter 1 and shows up as a green KR icon in Key Lento.
Dive at the purple chest markers and dig the treasure up with the metal detector; seven shipwrecks close the strand.
He drops out after Chapter 1 and comes back later by text, so an unfinished strand is not lost.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.

miss.note: Billy's jobs stay available after the story.

trophies.guide: Billy's five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub after Coffee Break (Chapter 2); the fifth, Hometown Heroes, awards it. Sources: PowerPyx walkthrough, GTABase.

steps.text: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Billy is marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Follow his jobs to the fifth and last, Hometown Heroes.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.

miss.note: GTABase: every qualifying strand stays available after the story.

trophies.guide: Finish eight qualifying stranger strands; the tracker counts strands, not single missions. Sources: PSNProfiles, GTABase.

steps.text: The counter goes up only when a stranger's whole questline ends, so finish strands before starting new ones.
Not every questline counts: GTABase confirms Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete, and rules out Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie.
The other qualifying strands are still being pinned down, so watch the trophy's own counter. None of them is needed for 100%.
No rush: PowerPyx notes that stranger quest givers stay in the world after the credits.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.

miss.note: PowerPyx: every trophy quest giver is still there after the story.

trophies.guide: Fill Randy's Wish List of 16 sports cars, opened by the Key Cloner mission in Chapter 3. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: Randy's Wish List asks for 16 vehicles. The one you hand over during the Chapter 3 story counts as one of them.
The list opens after Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS; scan cars with WAiNK to check them against it, and look on hotel driveways in Vice Beach and Ocean Beach.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.

miss.note: PowerPyx: every trophy quest giver is still there after the story.

trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand is Jason's, after Here, Kitty Kitty (Chapter 3); destroy the labs, then his last job ends it. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, Tyrone sends Jason after the synthetic labs marked purple around Vice City.
Once enough labs are down, his last mission shuts them for good and awards the trophy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.

miss.where: Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth
miss.note: The balcony meditation with Lucia is gone for good once Chapter 1 ends. No guide has confirmed whether the trophy needs it, so take it.

trophies.guide: 18 meditations at 10 spots. The first is a Chapter 1 scene with Lucia that is lost after that chapter, so accept it. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase, GamesRadar.

steps.text: After Down to Earth in Chapter 1, talk to Lucia in Jason's kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation.
Turning her down closes that spot for the rest of the game; GamesRadar also flags it as the one early risk.
Meditating with Jason and Lucia together counts twice; the last one needs both, possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
Track the 18 under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.

miss.note: Bret's Target Decks stay open after the story.

trophies.guide: Bret's hunting invite arrives after Coffee Break in Chapter 2; his Target Decks stay open after the story. Which animal counts is not confirmed yet. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: Jason gets Bret's hunting invitation once Coffee Break in Chapter 2 is done; Veteran Hunted in Lummox County starts it.
Hunt the purple-marked animals on his Target Decks and bring them back as Jason; a clean kill pays more but is optional.
No source yet names the animal that triggers it, and 100% needs all 15 decks anyway, so work through them.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

miss.note: Any three sets count, and cards stay collectable in free roam.

trophies.guide: Any three of the 18 card sets will do. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: PowerPyx counts 18 card sets; finish whichever three are easiest for you.
Progress > Collections shows how far along each set is.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

miss.note: Any 100 scans count, from a pool far larger than 100.

trophies.guide: Scan 100 spots with the WAiNK phone app: landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags all count. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: Open WAiNK on the phone and scan any mix of landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags until you reach 100.
GTABase tallies 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures before the tags, and opens the app with Up on the D-pad, then R1.

trophies.name: One Last Thing

miss.note: Any 50 of 80, and they stay open in free roam.

trophies.guide: Any 50 of the 80 challenges; 100% needs 70, so skip the hardest ten. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: Choose any 50 of the 80 challenges; many finish themselves as you play.
Progress > Challenges ticks off the ones you have done.
A Long Road wants 70, so you can still leave the ten hardest undone.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.

miss.note: Repeatable whenever both characters are together, from Chapter 2 on.

trophies.guide: Once partner free roam opens after Coffee Break (Chapter 2), get four stars with your partner along, then leave the red heat zone. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: Free roam with your partner opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
With the partner in tow, raise a four-star Wanted Level, break line of sight and get out of the red heat zone.
Bank vaults always bring four stars, so it often comes with Maximum Withdrawal; GTABase suggests the train tunnel north of Ambrosia to shake helicopters.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.

miss.note: Shops can be robbed again in free roam.

trophies.guide: The flashing pursuit must stay on between shops, not just the red zone; if the trophy does not pop, rob a fourth. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: Keep the active, flashing pursuit going while you drive between shops; staying in the red zone alone is not enough.
The three jewelry stores in north Vice City sit close together once Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3) are done.
It can lag about half a minute; if one robbery fails to count, carry on to a fourth shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good

miss.note: Traffic keeps spawning new models; 100 of 277 is needed.

trophies.guide: Scan new vehicles with WAiNK from the kerb; you never have to drive them. 100% needs 200, so this comes first. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: Point WAiNK at vehicles you have not logged yet; scanning is enough, no need to get in.
Standing by a busy road and scanning passing traffic is the quickest way, says GTABase.
The 100% checklist asks for 200 of 277 base models, so this unlocks halfway there.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.

miss.note: Any gang fight in free roam works.

trophies.guide: Use gang members as targets, with Focus upgraded and full. Police, soldiers and civilians may not count. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: Upgrade the Focus stat first so one activation lasts long enough for five takedowns.
Fill Focus before you start (eat, drink or wash at home), trigger it with both sticks while aiming and use an assault rifle.
Fight gang enemies; both guides report that police, soldiers and civilians may not count.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.

miss.note: The docked jets are there in free roam.

trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet docked at a VCIA boarding bridge (E3/E4, for example) and fly about 1 km away; jets parked on the airfield do not count. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: At VCIA, find a passenger jet attached to a boarding bridge; gates E3 and E4 are the easy pair.
Drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs beside the bridge to reach the plane.
Back it out, take off and fly roughly 1 km from the airport. Jets parked out on the airfield do not work.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank

miss.note: The tanks stay parked at the base.

trophies.guide: Take a Rhino tank from the south end of Mile Zero Air Station (Mariana County) and defeat enemies from inside it. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: Rhinos wait at the south end of Mile Zero Air Station, on the southwest island of Mariana County.
Climb in and keep taking down enemies from the tank until it unlocks.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.

miss.note: Jewelry stores can be robbed again in free roam.

trophies.guide: After Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3): Snap Gun the back door, open the safe with its code, wipe the footage and kill the alarm. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 first; they hand you the Snap Gun.
Pick a back door with the Snap Gun (kicking it trips the alarm), read the safe code from the note in the back room, wipe the cameras and stay unseen.
GTABase names Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City as a good target.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

miss.note: Vaults stay robbable after the story; 100% needs all 8.

trophies.guide: Any five of the eight bank vaults, opened by the optional Chapter 4 job That's Where The Money Is. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: There are eight large bank jobs; five vaults robbed and escaped is enough.
The optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is unlocks them: tail a security van to its bank and get in while the vault is open.
The haul is too heavy for one person, so pass a bag to your partner, then flee the four stars on a fast bike.
Hover over a bank's map icon to check whether you have already emptied its vault.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.

miss.note: Armored trucks and vaults recur in free roam.

trophies.guide: A bank vault job can count for this as well; it pops once you are out of the red heat zone. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: Rob an armored truck, or a bank vault job, which both guides say can also satisfy it.
For a truck, box it in, stick a bomb on the rear doors and blow them open.
It only unlocks after you leave the red heat zone or reach a Pay 'n' Spray.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State

miss.note: The map fog can be cleared any time.

trophies.guide: Lift the fog from the whole map (52 entries on the PS5 tracker); fly over the dark patches. Sources: PowerPyx, PSN 100%, GTABase.

steps.text: Clear every patch of map fog. Flying over what is left is much quicker than driving.
The PS5 tracker counts 52 exploration entries.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.

miss.note: Gang operations stay on the map; 100% needs all 39.

trophies.guide: One operation per gang, nine gangs; Progress > Gangs shows which are done. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: You need one robbed operation (yellow map icons) for each of the nine gangs, not all of them.
Progress > Gangs lists how many you have hit per gang; 100% later wants all 39.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.

miss.note: The rooftop bar is open in free roam.

trophies.guide: Ride the lift past the Ocean View pool to the rooftop bar, buy a cocktail and drink it at the beach-side railing. Sources: Gamer Social Club, TrueAchievements.

steps.text: At Ocean View, take the lift beyond the pool up to the rooftop bar.
Order a cocktail and drink it standing at the railing that faces the beach.
An Apple Martini is reported to work.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.

miss.note: The showroom car is there in free roam once you own the Key Cloner.

trophies.guide: Clone the key of the blue Banshee in the south Vice City showroom, then drive it out through the glass. Sources: PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies.org.

steps.text: In the showroom in south Vice City, use the Key Cloner (from Chapter 3) on the blue Banshee.
Drive that car straight through the window.
PlayStationTrophies.org found that driving any other car out of the window did nothing, and points to the blue Banshee from the trophy art.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.

miss.note: PowerPyx: the robbery respawns, so leftover valuables can be taken later.

trophies.guide: Rob Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn of its three key valuables: the luxury watch, the Gutterball Moreland 850 and the safe. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: The alley is Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, first marked by a Chapter 2 job.
Take all three: the watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table and the safe in the northeast hallway (bring sticky bombs).
It pops once the police lose you. Missing an item is fine: the robbery comes back after a long wait.

trophies.name: Personal Best

miss.note: Fitness clubs stay open, and home training opens after the story.

trophies.guide: Max Strength on Jason and Lucia together; bring your partner to a fitness club so you both train at once. Sources: HeistAtlas, GTABase.

steps.text: Both characters need maxed Strength at the same time; check it under Jason & Lucia > Strength.
Take your partner to a fitness club (Map > Activities): training one trains the other too.
After the story you can also work out at home.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

miss.note: Any action that moves the Criminal Profile counts. Irredeemable is permanent, but it only changes how police treat you, not the trophy.

trophies.guide: Anything that moves your Criminal Profile adds progress (the PS5 tracker counts to 500). Turn on profile notifications and stay out of Irredeemable, which is permanent. Sources: GTABase, PowerPyx, PSN 100%.

steps.text: Actions that change your Criminal Profile build this trophy's progress; enable Criminal Profile notifications under Settings > UI to see each change.
PowerPyx says every robbery and fight feeds it, so it usually arrives on its own during the other trophies.
Avoid the Irredeemable rating: both guides call it permanent, and it makes police harsher for the rest of the run.
The PS5 tracker runs to 500.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

miss.note: Two guides give the method, but one TrueAchievements player robbed the shop twice with no unlock, and no source says whether it stays open after the story.

trophies.guide: After Credit Check (Chapter 3), go back as Lucia alone to the prologue's Little Cuba Payday Loans, rob it again and escape on foot. Sources: PowerPyx, TrueAchievements.

steps.text: Wait until Credit Check in Chapter 3 hands you the Dye Pack Jammer.
As Lucia, without Jason, return to Payday Loans in Little Cuba from the prologue, rob it and get away on foot.
Do it soon after Chapter 3: a TrueAchievements commenter reports a repeat robbery that did not unlock it, so the trigger is not settled.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

miss.note: A one-off night encounter; neither source says whether it still spawns after the story, so do it before the finale.

trophies.guide: Alone, after 2 a.m., northwest of the Starlet Motel: follow the path from the blinking car to the UFO and help the woman. Sources: PowerPyx, GameSpot.

steps.text: Once Chapter 1 is over, go solo some time after 2 a.m. to the road northwest of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County.
Follow the trail from the car with flashing lights to the UFO, then agree to fetch the woman's car.
GameSpot says the abduction that follows is what unlocks it, and it starts a second UFO mystery later.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.

miss.note: Any motorcycle and any crowd will do, any time.

trophies.guide: Kick 10 pedestrians off a motorcycle inside 60 seconds; Ocean Beach is crowded enough. Sources: PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies.org.

steps.text: Ride a motorcycle and use melee kicks on pedestrians: ten within 60 seconds.
PlayStationTrophies.org reads the trophy art the same way: a kick from a bike at someone on foot.
Ocean Beach is one suggested spot for the crowds.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.

miss.note: A running total that the 100% robberies fill anyway.

trophies.guide: Credit Check (Chapter 3) unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer; marked bills turned in to fences add up across payouts. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: Clear Credit Check in Chapter 3 to get the Dye Pack Jammer.
Hand marked bills from banks and Payday Loans to fences; Yasmani in Vice City pays best, says GTABase.
The $250,000 is cumulative across every payout.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

miss.note: A running total; any shop, any time.

trophies.guide: Every shop purchase feeds one running total; you do not have to buy in every shop. Sources: GAMES.GG, GTABase.

steps.text: Purchases anywhere add to a single spending total of $100,000; one shop or many, it all counts.
Guns, car mods and tattoos burn through it fastest.

trophies.name: Little Boxes

miss.note: Garages stay on sale in the app.

trophies.guide: Buy the eight purchasable garages ($160,000 in all) in the Vice City Real Estate app after Daily Driver (Chapter 2); story garages do not count. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: The Vice City Real Estate app arrives after Daily Driver in Chapter 2.
Buy all eight purchasable garages, about $160,000 together. The four story garages are not part of it.
Robberies in Chapters 3 and 4 pay well enough to fund them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.

miss.note: Registration stays open in free roam.

trophies.guide: Scooter Bros opens after Moses (Chapter 2). Registering costs money and garage space, so register cheap cars and bikes after buying garages. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

steps.text: The Scooter Bros app installs after the Chapter 2 mission Moses.
Take stolen vehicles to his Port Gellhorn garage, respray and register them; from Chapter 3 any Pay 'n' Spray handles tracked cars too.
Each registration costs cash and needs garage space, so buy garages first (Little Boxes) and register cheap cars or bikes.
